vacancy.title: Senior Space Vehicle Design Engineer
vacancy.assessment: Strong technical fit with >10 years part-time hands-on mechanical design/CAD and machine development, MSc precision engineering and hardware ownership. Owns mechanical configuration and master CAD of high-performance optical satellite, interfaces, manufacturing drawings, tolerances and integration sequencing. Requires 8+ years mechanical design of complex assemblies, with space heritage desirable rather than essential. Major opportunity to enter spacecraft hardware engineering, though Delft rather than ESTEC, no published salary and Dutch VGB-B eligibility required. Official Axient careers PDF.
